verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a prompt-driven AI capability for drafting an initial bespoke S-1 and updating it 'with a few simple prompts.' Cooley AI is described as connecting AI to the firm's knowledge and workflows, but mainly to help its lawyers serve clients, so it is unclear that end users can delegate to it directly. The Cooley GO document generators show no built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of a user-facing built-in assistant in Cooley GO, delegation beyond S-1 drafting, details on how tasks are delegated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Update the S-1 as transaction terms change – all with a few simple prompts.
Complete an initial, bespoke S-1 draft in minutes rather than days
